### Fixes

- **Docker image platform checks** — Isolates published image platform verification into a separate job with proper platform isolation using QEMU for both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
- **PostgreSQL benchmark infrastructure** — New benchmarking framework to measure sample data load performance across different batch sizes and loading strategies for performance optimization.

### Fixes

- **Handle duplicates in first replace batch** — Duplicate keys in the initial batch of a replace operation are now properly deduplicated before being inserted into the database.

### Fixes

- **Mark ZIP complete only after all CSVs load** — Fix PostgreSQL loading to mark ZIP archives as processed only after all member CSV files load successfully, enabling proper retry behavior when individual files fail.

- **PostgreSQL replace mode preserves completed shards on restart** — When a pipeline is interrupted during replace mode loading and restarted, previously processed shards are no longer re-truncated, preventing data loss.
